asset: Hokkaido carved bear with salmon v27 - continuous jaw and anatomy study
reviewer: Direct inspection of genuine Blender Cycles same-camera v25-v27 GLB rendering and local trimesh topology verification

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Compact torso and rounded head remain visibly toy-like with unnatural limb taper; not significantly improved from v26.

face_and_expression.reason: The v26 jagged lower-jaw artifact is removed and chin surface appears continuous, but mouth geometry reads as a bulb below the fish rather than an enclosing jaw.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Actual salmon waist compressed with measurable jaw proximity (26/208 waist samples within 0.03 source units), but head and fish silhouette still read as a broad paddle resting under the snout.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Preserved v25 high-poly directional gouges; some surface areas remain unnaturally repetitive; not a production-ready handmade woodcarving.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Three-toe surface grooves and softened ankle contour remain; paw proportion and long upright legs still look like boots.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Full v25/v27 same-camera Blender Cycles render and genuine mesh exported; GLB main bear and salmon bodies independently verified watertight.

defects.finding: Bear nose still appears to rest on a large fish paddle; even with smooth chin and local contact, the front and 3/4 render do not show credible enclosed biting.
defects.required_fix: Use anatomically constrained multi-view sculpt in front/side, build a clear upper/lower jaw silhouette around the fish; don't use more local Gaussian distance tuning as substitute for correct anatomy.

defects.finding: Fish appears broad flat and pale, with minimal gill/eye features and geometric fins; contour does not read convincingly as a salmon.
defects.required_fix: Build salmon anatomy from separately authored dorsal/ventral/head landmarks; sculpt head, cheek/gill and caudal peduncle before material and shading.

defects.finding: Three-toe divisions visible but legs still shaped like boots, shoulder-to-wrist anatomy weak.
defects.required_fix: Replace original ring-loft limb blockout using reference matched ankle/hock and paw silhouette, preserve watertightness.

defects.finding: Directional chisel grooves are real mesh and recognizable, but repetitions still look patterned.
defects.required_fix: Keep real-mesh stroke method and improve stroke length and distribution based on anatomical regions, not random noise.

recommendation: Maintain v25 fur method and v27 anti-spike chin smoothing; build v28 independent silhouette-controlled head+salmon prototype, evaluate before whole-bear integration.
